description: This file defines the main screen for displaying a list of notes in a Flutter application. It manages loading, searching, creating, editing, and deleting notes, and contains UI components such as app bar, search bar, list view, and floating action button.

classes.name: NotesListScreen
classes.description: Main screen widget displaying the list of notes with search, create, edit, and delete functionalities.

classes.name: _NotesListScreenState
classes.description: State class managing the notes list, user interactions, and UI updates.

classes.name: _EmptyState
classes.description: Stateless widget rendering the UI when there are no notes or search results.

classes.name: _NoteListTile
classes.description: Widget displaying individual note item with title, body, update time, and delete button.

methods.name: _loadNotes
methods.description: Loads notes from storage and updates the state.

methods.name: _persist
methods.description: Saves current notes list to storage.

methods.name: _createNote
methods.description: Creates a new note, navigates to editor, and updates the list based on result.

methods.name: _editExisting
methods.description: Edits an existing note, handles update or deletion based on editor result.

methods.name: _deleteNote
methods.description: Confirms and deletes a note from the list.
